messages.subject: Re: h2 mismatch in generate.mirt_object
parts:
generate.mirt_object() also has a latent_means and latent_covariance input. You need to use the latter to also include the linear covariation information between the traits. This incidentally affects the h2 statistic as well. HTH.

Phil


On Fri, Jun 14, 2019 at 5:56 PM B <brandon....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Phil, 


I'm using mirtCAT to convert parameters from a mirt model object so that I can use the mirtCAT model object to generate theta scores so that I can keep the primary data that was used to estimate the models private. 

The primary issue is that when I use the coefficients from a testlet model to mirtCAT::generate.mirt_object the comparisons of summaries do not match. The loadings appear to match, but the estimates for h2 are different. I'm unsure of how to get these parameters to match. 

I've attached a script to reproduce the issue

Thank you.
